newsitems.title: Valve reassures Team Fortress 2 players that it's still working on the Mann vs Machine update it announced last year: 'We promise we're making progress'
newsitems.author: Rick Lane
newsitems.contents: I had completely forgotten that Valve is working on an update for Team Fortress 2's cooperative Mann vs. Machine mode, though in my defence, it's been a long time since we last heard about it. The prospective patch was announced in June last year, via a blog post on TF2's official website that requested map and mission submissions from the community in time for this update—with a "fictional deadline" of August 27... Read more.

newsitems.title: Valve say the Team Fortress 2 MvM update is still coming and they're still working on it

newsitems.title: Call of Duty® and Aston Martin Unveil the Dreadnought for Modern Warfare® 4
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0d1f4a12856e4f1b5640b9d0d42502e8a9625204.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Introducing the Dreadnought[/h3][p][/p][p]Every so often a vehicle drops into [i]Call of Duty[/i] that stands apart from the rest. Today, [i]Call of Duty[/i] and Aston Martin are proud to reveal that vehicle, the Aston Martin Dreadnought, an in-game, bespoke tactical SUV concept created for [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]™. Developed through a collaboration between Aston Martin’s design team and engineered from the ground up with Infinity Ward, the Dreadnought reimagines what happens when one of the world’s most iconic ultra-luxury performance brands enters the world of [i]Modern Warfare[/i]. This is one of the most aggressive all-wheel drive machines in the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/db29101b300d40b76b2dbf2001a58ffac57fd523.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]When Luxury Meets Tactical Performance[/h3][p][/p][p]Designed by the same Aston Martin team responsible for some of the marque’s most celebrated vehicles, the Dreadnought is an exploration of what’s possible when designers are freed from real-world constraints.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ef000566858cba7d55f21a55688323cfaa8fa34b.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Drive to survive[/h3][p][/p][p]The Dreadnought rolls with an armored exterior and military-grade armor plating. This isn't a joyride SUV that folds under the first burst of fire. It's a mobile fortress. Push objectives and drive straight through contested ground while its impressive armor plating helps absorb the heaviest of incoming fire.[/p][p][/p][h3]The most aggressive AWD in MW4[/h3][p][/p][p]Grounded in Modern Warfare's in-game physics and packing supercar-level performance, the Dreadnought is the most aggressive all-wheel drive in the game. This translates to brutal traction, real speed, and the momentum to ram, escape, or run down a squad that thought it had you cornered — all announced by the roar of a full-blooded V12 engine.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fed0500b10b280a29ebf4b328bcc7e2acb7bbf56.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/02706d0bd289bc2ff97377783b2781809f73f0d7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fcf2aad1e915fc34161f0490f3330407e71b0ba3.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e9b2715ab0ca26119c8e8837e3cc5f6646d7252c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/511329bb9d1eeb66a444f3fd139c42f51fd3d9b8.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a5b5bd2a0fb58e6720b4d0ca2d6fb857a767673e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9d9348360fb59057ecc686db3bd1b3c10d7c3350.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/04ed158bfe8421422ac4a537cb57a4ce63b9444f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b1a0edb3a5addbb10f1c7460b85c6b8cb1edc095.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Aston Martin Dreadnought concept photography shown.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]A Closer Look at the Aston Martin Dreadnought[/h3][p][/p][p]The capabilities of a performance SUV have been translated into an immersive virtual world for the next generation of Aston Martin fans. Grounded in the in-game physics of the [i]Call of Duty[/i] universe, this unapologetic, uncompromising tactical all-wheel drive SUV delivers not only a stunning exploration of extreme visual language, but also an engaging and dynamic player experience. [/p][p][/p][p]The Dreadnought name naturally conjures up images of military might. Aside from its obvious dictionary definition, “fear nothing”, it also recalls the famous early 20th Century British warship, [i]HMS Dreadnought[/i], which was so revolutionary in terms of her armament and propulsion that she coined an entirely new class of warship, defining global naval military ambition in the early 1900s.  The Dreadnought combines supercar levels of performance, advanced armor technologies, and adaptive combat zone intelligence systems into a single, striking form. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/554282834cd87a056a675fa5dcc4108180836be4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Though these elements are purely cosmetic in the game, all have been imagined for elite tactical performance: from its optimized aerodynamics to its fully integrated digital command interfaces. Exquisite design details emphasize the Dreadnought’s high luxury heritage: from the herringbone weave of the exterior carbon fiber to the Oxford Tan leather dashboard and door panel details, and the metallic gold gear lever. These are uniquely contrasted in this digital creation with features rarely found in an Aston Martin like military grade armor plating. [/p][p][/p][h3]Amplified without restraint: Unmistakably Aston Martin[/h3][p][/p][p]Commenting on the debut of the Dreadnought in [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i], Aston Martin Chief Creative Officer, Marek Reichman, said: “The team have hugely enjoyed the not inconsiderable challenge of redefining what an Aston Martin can be when the only limit is imagination. [/p][p][/p][p]“To create the ultimate exotic off-road machine, I had to imagine Dreadnought not only as a digital asset, but as a vehicle living in the real world — navigating the streets of New York, powering through the monsoon-soaked roads of Mumbai, and performing with complete authenticity in every environment,” Reichman said. “That vision allowed us to create something that feels genuinely real, even within the immersive world of the game.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3fb3623736367c301aed57b993a1a04d64dda0df.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1bba46c88ba10814787b71bdc3824e47e5f7adca.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/33a20fe66bc458cad3b0b363d621ae131b31f1cb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bcb1480136477b2bd5e31d659aac8da23febb992.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e07e364958a4fb1c3b92f05ee6500ed5bd99d21e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d8e9465282337d4a9020913f191e4447955089ca.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8d8543c5f09ae1a0c38b38a4c1d701348846fa25.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2f07051cf9429ceb11c32e882dccc752dc038d82.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a8266a71ca3eb55b989eca15ec3d1c3a84f85971.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/44ab3513f706e1f4328a10b3beee35f1b1d2ee7c.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Aston Martin Dreadnought in-game imagery shown.

[/i]“To me, Dreadnought is unmistakably an Aston Martin — amplified without restraint. The quality of the details we have been able to include, right down to the iconic Chiltern Green paint color so synonymous with this marque, underscores our dedication to delivering a truly authentic Aston Martin experience,” Reichman said. “Features as diverse as the carbon fiber chassis right through to exquisite elements such as the door hinges in anodized Satin Gold, reflect our real-world determination to be the most desirable ultra-luxury brand in the automotive sector, and beyond.”[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d72106a962457c99f954e40f385a6ecdd6151704.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Built Together with Infinity Ward[/h3][p][/p][p]Bringing the Dreadnought to life required close collaboration between Aston Martin and Infinity Ward throughout every stage of development, from concepting and vehicle geometry to animation, in-game physics, propulsion, and gameplay tuning. Every element was engineered to reflect Aston Martin's distinctive design philosophy while delivering a high-performance armored vehicle purpose-built for Modern Warfare 4. The results, explains a member of Infinity Ward’s design team, is “a high performance armored vehicle that stays true to Aston Martin’s distinctive design philosophy and dominates any battleground. This is the most aggressive all-wheel drive vehicle in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i].” [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/33a20fe66bc458cad3b0b363d621ae131b31f1cb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]See It First at Fanatics Fest NYC, Drive it in game on October 23[/h3][p][/p][p]Fans attending Fanatics Fest NYC will have the opportunity to see a full-size physical interpretation of the Dreadnought before it arrives in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]At launch players can locate the Dreadnought within a few key points of interest across both [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] DMZ and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i].[/p]

newsitems.title: Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer: Kill Block Intel
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c79f93ed48a51ad0de555cf3aa5cde247c52d04d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Kill Block: A First Look (at Fanatics Fest)
[/h2][p][i]Kill Block Explained
[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]SUMMARY: [/b]Fanatics Fest attendees are among the first members of the public experiencing Kill Block. Here's a closer look at the adaptive Multiplayer battleground and how it fits into Modern Warfare 4's broader Multiplayer offering.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="SJt5bbgQ-TQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Fanatics Fest NYC takes place July 16–19 at New York City's Javits Center, and attendees are the first members of the public to experience Kill Block, one of Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4's new Multiplayer experiences. As players battle across the adaptive training facility throughout the event, we're taking a deeper look at the mode itself, from its modular battleground design and military engineering to its expanded Gunfight experiences and the future of the facility within Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer.[/p][p][/p][p]Read on, and we'll cover the following:[/p][p][/p][h3]Blog Summary[/h3][p][/p][p][b]What is Kill Block?[/b] Learn about the West Bridge Advanced Military Training Facility, an adaptive live-fire environment where modular battlegrounds reconfigure before every match, creating hundreds of unique combat configurations.[/p][p][/p][p][b]How Kill Block Works:[/b] Go behind the scenes at the facility to discover how the facility's massive modular Slabs move into place, how configurations are assembled, and what tactical opportunities each environment provides.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Safety Off Beyond This Point:[/b] Get the tactical rundown on battles within Kill Block matches, including 3v3 Gunfight and the all-new Gunfight 10v10 modes, and a look at how the facility is being built to support additional core Multiplayer modes after launch.[/p][p][/p][p]Let's take a closer look at Kill Block...[/p][p][/p][h2]So What Exactly is Kill Block?[/h2][p][i]An Adaptive Live-Fire Training Environment
[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]SUMMARY:[/b] Kill Block is a modular Multiplayer battleground that reconfigures every match, challenging players to rethink routes, sightlines, and combat spaces on the fly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ae715cd91fef1c84700767dda0cd54c3ab6b0cbc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Welcome to the West Bridge Advanced Military Training — codenamed Kill Block — an off-the-books facility specializing in modular Multiplayer battlegrounds centered on reconfiguring combat layouts. Designed as a live-fire training environment, Kill Block maps reconfigure between matches, forcing players to reassess sightlines, routes, and combat spaces.[/p][p][/p][p]At its core, Kill Block is assembled from three modular sections — two outer areas (“End Slabs”) and one central combat space (“Central Slab”) — that combine into a new combat configuration after each match called a “Combo”. Each section and how they are positioned allows for multiple possible Combo variants, creating hundreds of unique layout combinations that reshape combat flow.[/p][p][/p][p]Most map sections are entirely new, while others draw inspiration from iconic locations across Modern Warfare history. At launch on October 23, more than 500 configurations are possible, with layouts reconfiguring between matches and throughout Gunfight rounds to transform sightlines, routes, cover placement, and engagement pacing.[/p][p][/p][p]Kill Block supports expanded Gunfight experiences, including 3v3 and the new Gunfight 10v10 mode at launch, with future support planned for more core Multiplayer modes.[/p][p][/p][p]Kill Block: Learn the layout. Adapt when it changes.[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s take a closer look at the West Bridge Advanced Military Training Facility:[/p][p][/p][h2]How Kill Block Works: Engineering Overview[/h2][p][i]Modular Combat Systems
[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]SUMMARY:[/b] Discover how West Bridge's massive towers, motors, rails, and modular Slabs work together to physically reconfigure the combat space between matches.
[/p][/*][/list][p]An impressive feat of military engineering, this self-contained compound features a perimeter of eight massive concrete towers that house an array of electronics, motors, and pulley systems. These are attached to three massive steel-reinforced Slabs that sit within the facility's perimeter, each resting on a network of rail-mounted wheel assemblies known as bogies that travel along tracks embedded above and below the training area.[/p][p][/p][p]When a change of map occurs between matches, the active Slab decouples from the others and is slowly lowered by electric motors into a dedicated storage chamber beneath the arena. A synchronized motor array then switches the rail network to a different Slab, which is winched into position and locked in place, transforming the combat space for the next exercise.[/p][p][/p][p]The result is an ever-changing Combo map that enables Tier One Operator teams to experience a variety of Shoothouse-style environments across numerous combat scenarios.[/p][p][/p][h3]What are Kill Block Combos and Slabs?[/h3][p]Slabs are sectional environments constructed specifically for military training purposes, and there are three linked together in every Kill Block match. Mocked up streets, compounds, and urban blocks provide faithful facsimiles of real-world environments, with many assembled from shipping containers, timber-framed structures, temporary facades, and training props. This is a full-scale tactical set, each built to evoke the character of an operational environment with recognizable spaces, and constructed with a variety of scenery, vantage points, verticality, chokepoints, routes, low openings, and sightlines that typically extend across to an adjacent Slab, and occasionally across the entire map. Three of these Slabs fitted together form a Combo, which is the entire map a match takes place on.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9273f0d3f193026659604d3de9431584b31c036c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/57ead1159e1763ebc99ded75773bd005b5362c48.jpg"][/img][i]Two Kill Block Combos, one completely different match: Note the \[Station], \[Shoot House], and \[Woods] Slabs (first image) and the \[Killhouse]], \[Ambush], and \[Snow Block] Slabs (second image), slotting together to create a completely different environment.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Checking Slabs more thoroughly, you can expect to find parked trucks, burned-out tanks and cars, stacked gabions, cargo containers, live-fire training rooms, prefabricated multi-level buildings, concrete blocks, barriers, and walls, and a few tactically important doors you can shoot open, barge through or open slowly with stealth in mind. Construction markings, grenade marks, arrows, named labels for each Slab, training targets, named rooms (using duct tape floor markers), number markings, and a host of other scenic elements are there to assist in your spatial awareness as you learn the environments.[/p][p][/p][h3]Slab Configurations[/h3][p]Each set of three Slabs — a Combo — is rectangular in shape, and always the same footprint size (roughly that of the Modern Warfare (2019) map “Shoot House”). Every Slab is self-contained, but with the necessary openings to allow flow throughout the map to adjacent Slabs. Every match involves traversing all three of these slabs, which are connected along their longitudinal edges to form the entire Combo playspace.  Here’s how the two slab types differ:
[/p][p][b]End Slabs:[/b] There are always two End Slabs on each Kill Block match map, and each of them is one third of the play space and connects to each side of the Central Slab. Teams enter via an infil armory room and into their End Slab, with a perimeter wall gate closing behind them at the start of a match. End Slabs always have these gates (labeled A or B) on the outer wall, directly opposite the other, and in non-Gunfight modes, team members will spawn in and around the back portion of their End Slab.[/p][p][/p][p]After spawning, teams with tactical know-how usually move forwards towards the Central Slab with the safety off. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b6602a3a0726cb9845da6518235090ec7403a4b4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Central Slabs:[/b] Linked on each side to an End Slab, the middle of the map offers scenery particularly crafted to enhance combat coming in from multiple angles, with a variety of commanding vantage points, chokepoints, and defensive positions. Teams can move freely between all three slabs.[/p][p][/p][h3]Environmental Challenges[/h3][p]Certain Slabs are fitted with military-grade weather simulation arrays along with powerful fans that propel vast quantities of misting water or snow across the slab’s entirety. With inclement conditions and the possibility of rain or snow flurries, Operators need to adapt to shifting visibility, altering sightlines, and other evolving tactical conditions. Expect weapons to also react to the weather, with ice particles or a wet sheen building up on the weapon until you swap armaments or reload.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/aad547ba534f443ad01218286e366e618a79f374.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2aecd7f64b2c352862c0f9250fc16bb1c827dc92.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Before and after a snow flurry within the central Slab “Crash”.[/i][/p][h3][i]
[/i]Veteran Terrain[/h3][p]While most Slabs are entirely new, others recreate iconic locations including Crash from Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (2007), Storage Town from Call of Duty: Warzone’s Verdansk map and Shoot House from Modern Warfare (2019). Paired with different neighboring Slabs, these familiar spaces play in entirely new ways. Though drawn from iconic maps, these Slabs are fundamentally recontextualized by the randomized environments surrounding them, allowing familiar terrain to deliver both the classic moments you remember and entirely new tactical experiences.[/p][p][/p][h3]Kill Block Map Situational Overview[/h3][p]Every Kill Block match is fought across a random selection of three Slabs bolted to each other. When this larger map in its entirety is measured, the entire area is roughly the same size as the Modern Warfare (2019) map “Shoot House”.
 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/91733a5e3deb76ddd9d13ec02238d2fe0f765a06.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d8b5ee3812ca42ae865eefe5408c609690513526.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Ensure your situational awareness by checking the perimeter walls so you know where you are. Note the “B4” and “B3” location wall markers in both wildly different Combos.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]For those needing more tactical awareness, the perimeter of the map has indications of smaller sections that serve as visual reference points, helping you identify your location more rapidly while you glance at the mini-map for red dots. Along the map’s longer north and south wall perimeter, there are six “A” and “B” sectors respectively, while the shorter east and west walls have two “C” and “D” sectors, each between an entrance gate where each team spawns. You’re able to tell where you are due to each perimeter section’s letter and number emblazoned at intervals around the map’s perimeter wall.[/p][p][/p][p]Use all this knowledge as you learn your Kill Block environments to pinpoint enemies over your comms and learn the maps you’re dropped into.[/p][p][/p][h2]“Safety Off Beyond This Point”: General Tactical Awareness[/h2][p][i]Learn. Adapt. Dominate.[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]SUMMARY:[/b] Know your terrain by studying each Slab's layout, movement options, and sightlines, then apply that knowledge in a changing mix of combat environments.
[/p][/*][/list][p]As you learn the layouts of the different slabs, you’re able to tactically piece together sightlines that carry across the entire Kill Block space itself. It’s worth remembering there are spray-painted signs branding a wall that names most slabs, as well as the names of each Slab appearing during the infil as the map reconfigures between matches, enabling you to quickly ascertain which slabs you’re playing on and learn their layouts the longer you play.
[/p][p]Furthermore, with Modern Warfare 4’s full suite of refined and fluid movement mechanics, expect to be able to scramble across Slab scenery with the same rapid dexterity as you would during a Core Multiplayer match. This includes vertical positioning: climbing onto rooftops, atop containers, onto upper balconies, and ascending to other areas that offer advantageous sightlines at the expense of exposure. Kill Block’s adaptive Multiplayer maps have been designed to offer tactical benefits and creative challenges no matter where you’re positioned.[/p][p][/p][h3]Kill Block Slab Examples[/h3][p]The following examples and the video footage within this Blog highlight just a selection of the dozens of Slabs available at launch, each offering its own tactical opportunities and combat challenges. Note that the names of Slabs are subject to change prior to the game’s launch:
[/p][p][b]\[ Ambush ] // Central Slab:[/b] A slice of the classic Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare map, this training facsimile features a convoy-clogged main road with blown-out pre-fab buildings either side, with plenty of elevated sniper nests that look across the adjacent End Slabs. [/p][p][/p][p][b]\[ Blacksite ] // End Slab:[/b] Three prefabricated structures are positioned around the slab with open access between each of them, with mud and grass thoroughfare, a rusted van, open cargo container, and stacked military gabions as well as concrete barrier stacks to tactically maneuver between.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[ Killhouse ] // End Slab:[/b] A section of the seminal Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare map, with a similar aesthetic, with gabions placed at corners of prefab walls, some with gaps to climb over, with a central kill box in the middle, and smaller scenic cover opportunities along the far edge of the Slab.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[ ME-Town ] // Central Slab:[/b] A kill box dirt courtyard surrounded by four prefabricated structures, roughly in each corner, some with significant interior and roof top space available for long-range overwatch coverage. The main turquoise building is a warren of tight rooms and scramble points constructed with mobility training in mind.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[ Snow Block ] // End Slab:[/b] A maze of stacked gabion walls of varying lengths, along with tactically positioned open cargo containers and other concrete blocks. Operators must weigh the benefits of overwatching from the top of these fortifications, as your line sights improve at the expense of cover.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[ Trench ] // Central Slab:[/b] A no-man’s land of sunken mud walls and pill boxes with sandbags, tires, and wooden trusses keeping the dirt trenches from collapsing. The action is particularly fraught in the exposed middle with concrete barriers, and a burned tank offer a modicum of protection and sight lines.[/p][p][/p][h2]Kill Block: Live-Fire Gunfights[/h2][p][i]High-Stakes Team Combat[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]SUMMARY:[/b] Gunfight returns with 3v3 and the all-new 10v10 modes, where shared loadouts, single-life rounds, and decisive teamwork determine every victory.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]On October 23, Kill Block launches with expanded Gunfight experiences, featuring both 3v3 and the all-new Gunfight 10v10 modes. Every round pits teams against one another in fast-paced, single-life combat with every elimination carrying weight and every surviving teammate influencing a round outcome. Communicate effectively, capitalize on opportunities, and execute under pressure to claim victory.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4e5c6b8e99ac1bcb8a12c6fa894a15486288bda2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Each round begins with all Operators equipped with the same randomized Primary and Secondary Weapons, Tactical and Lethal Equipment, ensuring every player starts on equal footing. There are no custom Loadouts to rely on, placing the emphasis squarely on teamwork, weapon proficiency, and tactical decision making. If neither team is eliminated before the round timer expires, an Overtime Flag deploys into the combat zone, forcing both teams to converge on it. Capture this Flag to claim victory or fight to maintain the health advantage if time runs out.[/p][p][/p][p]During Kill Block Gunfight matches, teams swap sides after the first round. After the second round ends, the three Slabs change to a new Combo (map), a new random loadout is equipped, and the match continues. Combos continue to change every two rounds until one of the teams wins six rounds.[/p][p][/p][p]While Gunfight 3v3 and 10v10 headlines Kill Block at launch, the West Bridge Advanced Military Training Facility has been engineered as a modular combat platform capable of supporting additional core Multiplayer modes in future post-launch seasons. Players can expect the facility's adaptive battlegrounds to provide fresh tactical challenges across an expanding variety of Multiplayer modes.[/p][p][/p][h2]Beyond Kill Block: The Complete Multiplayer Offering[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bac70e54847c575b42c8d0f5dde96f976fc6b6e0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]From the adaptive battlegrounds of Kill Block to the globe-spanning Core MP maps, large-scale Ground War battles, tactical one-life modes, fan-favorite respawn and round-based playlists, and Party Modes, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer is built for every possible engagement. Alongside Kill Block, players can look forward to: 
[/p][list][*][p]12 grounded Core multiplayer maps set across globally diverse locations, each built around distinct visual identities and tactical flow, with two additional favorites dropping just after launch.

Every Core map features its own custom insignia and visual branding inspired by the location, operation, or conflict surrounding the environment, from Lotus (a Korean fishing village in the aftermath of an amphibious assault) to Rooftops (the snow-lined rooftops of a New York Hotel) and Mumbai (a fugitive’s hideout inside a dense residential district).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Larger scale battles with armored vehicles across expansive maps, featuring brutally intense combined-arms warfare.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A full suite of Multiplayer Modes and Hardcore variants, from fan favorites like Team Deathmatch, Domination and Hardpoint to new modes with full reveals in the weeks to come.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Expect Party Modes to also arrive at launch, with additional modes coming shortly after release.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you prefer chasing the objective, coordinating with your squad, or simply racking up eliminations, there's a mode built to match your playstyle.[/p][p][/p][h2]Additional Intel Incoming[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0cd59c7a91551190f88b01565f9100fe5faa2281.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Stay tuned to the Call of Duty Blog for the latest official Modern Warfare 4 intel as we move toward additional information drops before the Modern Warfare 4 launch on October 23.  Preorders are available now at participating retailers, in-game, on platform stores, or at CallofDuty.com. For more information on preordering, including Vault Edition content, rewards, and a special Loyalty Discount, [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/05/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-preorder-benefits-game-editions-details"]see the Preorder blog here[/url]. [/p][p][/p][h2]Development Credits[/h2][p]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on PC via Steam on Friday, October 23, 2026. [/p][p][/p][p]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox for Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]Additional development by in alphabetical order: Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Warzone - Season 05
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c19ba9d6ae099beab0b7a6da34a6cc405e53a2d1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Unleash the Arsenal: Black Ops Season 05[/u][/h2][p][/p][h3]Season 05 Roadmap[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cf500592871675ae7be988eb257ce0178bcc9537.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Across [i]Call of Duty® Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]™, Season 05 delivers a huge season of content. Multiplayer brings a hard-hitting lineup led by the brand-new Jubilee map, set in a rural town in Japan where the action never stops. In Zombies, rip through the undead in a new Survival map at launch and prepare to confront the Warden in the epic Mid-Season conclusion to the [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Zombies story. In Endgame, race against the clock in the new Burn Run Assignment and further enhance your Operator with Ability Boosts.[/p][p][/p][p]Plus, push the action even further with new events, Weekly Challenges, a brand-new Battle Pass, a serving of new weapons including the FG42 Assault Rifle, Gremlin SMG, and Mammoth LMG, and much more.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="kfDcQB6KPME;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Season 05 is armed and ready for action. Own the stage and get ready to fight when new free and premium content arrives in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7[/i] Season 05, launching on July 23 at 9AM PT across all platforms.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Endgame Content[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]FREE TO PLAY: ENDGAME CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Assignment:[/b] Take to the roads in a bomb-rigged vehicle in the new Burn Run Assignment, challenging Operators to a race against the clock while running over enemies and objects to add valuable seconds to the timer. Stick to the path, seek out bonuses en route, and don’t let up on that gas pedal.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Ability Boosts:[/b] Further customize your Operator with the addition of Ability Boosts, earnable primarily in Nightmare zones with a chance to drop in Zone IV. Ability Boosts add additional upgrades to your Major and Minor Abilities, from reducing their cooldown time to adding more ammo, inflicting additional damage types, and more.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Free to Play Ends Soon:[/b] Season 05 is your last chance to jump into Endgame for free with your squad. Don’t miss out![/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][h3]New Assignment: Burn Run (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/264562cda695cf2248f3662e4f7aea86e2070438.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Get pumped in Avalon with the new Burn Run Assignment, challenging Operators to a race against the clock in a bomb-rigged vehicle that’s ready to explode. As the music rages on, step on the gas and pass through all thirty arches, each one embroiled in flames so you know exactly where to go.[/p][p][/p][p]The pathway is littered with Fear enemies and objects; run them over to add additional seconds to the clock and seek out bonuses like repair wrenches and speed boosts to keep your vehicle in working order as you blast through the racecourse. Keep your eyes on the road, hit everything in your path, and get to the destination.[/p][p][/p][h3]Exotic Ability Boosts (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/24d90bd22eca3d5fcce2f4205fdef45381a5a828.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Upgrade your Major and Minor Abilities with new, rare enhancements that can be acquired in the match, further empowering them with advantages including reduced cooldown times, extra ammo, the chance to inflict additional damage types, and other bonuses improving their effectiveness in the field.[/p][p][/p][p]Found in item cases, Ability Boosts are mixed in with other reward types and are chosen based on your currently equipped Major and Minor Ability. Though Ability Boosts have a small chance to drop in Zone IV regions, they are primarily found in Nightmare locations. Open your Tac Map and check the rewards list of various Nightmare level Activities and Assignments to discover where you have the best chance of discovering them.[/p][p][/p][p]Each Major and Minor Ability has two Exotic Ability boosts to choose from. Once acquired, the Ability Boost will remain until you either wipe or swap out the affected Ability.[/p][p][/p][h2]Free to Play Throughout S05[/h2][p]Endgame’s free-to-play period is planned to continue through to the conclusion of Season 05, so be sure to jump in with your squad to explore all that Avalon has to offer in this expansive PvE mode. Once Season 06 of [i]Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] begins, Endgame will no longer be accessible via the [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] menu and will be available only to [i]Black Ops 7[/i] owners.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: Multiplayer Content[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Maps:[/b] Crash the party at a rural Japanese festival in the brand-new Jubilee map and deploy to remastered maps Dig and Frequency. In the Mid-Season, invade a Nuketown pinball machine in Turbo Tilt and jump, dive, and traverse a harrowing parkour environment with the arrival of a new Freerun map.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Modes:[/b] Power up your Operator while capturing and defending objectives in Overdrive Domination. In Gauntlet Rush, compete for the top spot across five different game modes, and in the Mid-Season, turn the adrenaline up to eleven in Cranked Moshpit. [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Black Ops 7 Ranked Play:[/b] Get wins and climb the Ranks in the next season of Multiplayer Ranked Play, delivering new rewards to those who prove their worth in the rankings.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p][/p][p]Jubilee (Launch)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f7f81a715e30fb2b5f3b80be9463098b00a378ef.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Fight through a rural Japanese town as a festival turns to chaos and the streets erupt in conflict. Battle in the front courtyard of the Palace museum, explore local cuisine in the pop-up Festival, and test your luck in the pachinko room offering low and standard rates. For a more scenic path, traverse the outer Garden running behind residential spaces above street level.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a99dc89176d1fdb93512fc8387c23b96173280f7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]For long-ranged skirmishes, head down the central Main Street running down the length of the map where scattered vehicles provide some cover throughout. For tighter encounters, flank out to the sides where there’s a greater mix of sightlines, giving every playstyle a chance to shine in the celebratory scene.[/p][p][/p][p]Frequency (Launch)[/p][p][i]Remaster, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/35f5630a44832bbf0fb5dd980d04a3e311612d35.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]First introduced in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, Frequency returns fully remastered with greater detail than ever before. Deploy deep into the mountains of Hunan where Operators engage in constant battle over control of the listening station’s global surveillance capabilities.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/43aad05db1fc79898301981b47405b7842aa5cc6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Take in the sights along the outer platform as you battle down the infamous Catwalk and Pipes sections on the perimeter, or head inside the facility for close-quarters action in the Surveillance room and amongst the Servers. The map opens up in the middle with skirmishes breaking out all around the circular pathway; drop down into the Maintenance area to travel below the path. Whatever your approach, make liberal use of the Wall Jump for new angles of attack while throwing off the enemy’s aim.  [/p][p][/p][p]Dig (Launch)[/p][p][i]Remaster, 6v6, Small-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c732e8e8812fae34344a084e9a74754109cd976d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Following its debut in Call of Duty: Black Ops 2, Dig returns in remastered form, sending Operators to an archaeological dig site in Avalon where rival forces clash over what lies beneath. With the enhanced movement of Black Ops 7, now’s your chance to experience the map like never before.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9ddfc36c26df339a53aa5317b9dd1dbdd12347b1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Battle along exposed ruins with bas-reliefs of ancient battles and statues commemorating long forgotten figures. Featuring a roughly rectangular layout, the map is full of equipment and scaffolding to repair the crumbling architecture, creating a myriad of narrow, twisting routes that occasionally open up onto long distance vantage points, pits dug into the ground, secret passageways, and flanking routes that are ideal for setting up ambush.[/p][p][/p][p]Turbo Tilt (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8eeb198b0f583784ae4448d1236c3d4f564b1a73.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Shrink down to size and battle inside the Nuketown Turbo Era Rampage pinball machine in Turbo Tilt, a wild Mid-Season Multiplayer map inspired by the history of Nuketown. Encounter a lit up mushroom cloud in the center where a boulder sized pinball occasionally passes through crushing unlucky Operators in its path. Take cover behind bumpers and flippers and fire from the upper window of the Green House just like in the original. Push the opposition, obtain a high score, and finish the match in style.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/54e3b9a363de81607435840462b43a4f7b780509.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Freerun: Descent (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Brand-New[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/86ce666ddbee7c0ad5bcd88ff541c8827b3a3d5f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Guild expects nothing less than the absolute best from its pool of Operators, and that begins with training as the company brings a new obstacle course into play. Jump, dive, slide, and more across an all-new Freerun map arriving in the Mid-Season.[/p][p][/p][h2]Multiplayer Limited-Time Modes [/h2][p][/p][p]Overdrive Domination (Launch)[/p][p][i]New Mode (Moshpit)[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ecd028a3785cde06e9f6678761610ca8985dc574.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Domination comes to Overdrive bringing an objective-based twist to the high-octane game mode. Capture, hold, and defend objectives while eliminating targets with style to earn stars for your team.[/p][p][/p][p]Earn additional stars for impressive Eliminations based on the following criteria:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Earn 1 star for Basic Eliminations.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn 2 stars for Core Medal Eliminations.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn 3 stars for completing Distinguished Medal Eliminations.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Earning stars grants special Operator bonuses, as follows:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]1 Star: Cognition Uplink: Increased perception to help you find your next target.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]3 Stars: Hyper Speed: Increased movement speed to reach your target faster.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]6 Stars: Ballistic Overdrive: Increased weapons handling to help you eliminate your target.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Stay in the fight to keep your star counter climbing. If you are eliminated or wait too long between actions, your star count will return to zero. Operators who manage to achieve six stars in a single combo will trigger Overdrive, doubling all earned stars while active.[/p][p][/p][p]Gauntlet Rush (Launch)[/p][p][i]New Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d3dd13e114f7d1534a7a78258f85a08c958b5bd5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Keep pushing and don’t let up in the new Gauntlet Rush mode, rewarding Operators who constantly engage the enemy and complete objectives across a rotating set of five modes: Team Deathmatch, Kill Confirmed, Domination, Hardpoint, and Roulette.[/p][p][/p][p]Each game mode lasts for two minutes before seamlessly switching to the next one within the same map to keep the action hot. Eliminate enemies and play the objective to rev up toward Operator enhancements including faster movement speed, weapon swap speed, and improved headshot damage. [/p][p][/p][p]Check the lower lefthand corner of your HUD to see how close you are to earning the next buff; the gauge drops if you fail to engage the next target or objective quickly enough, so stay active and reap the rewards. Throughout the match, look out for Gain Stacks that drop in the environment, providing a huge score boost to help reach that next devastating Scorestreak.[/p][p][/p][p]Cranked Moshpit (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Turn up the heat with the debut of Cranked in Black Ops 7. Eliminate enemies to activate the Cranked timer and earn buffs like faster movement, reload speed, and other upgrades. Your life ends when the timer does, so keep it active through constant slaying. Hit zero and you explode.[/p][p][/p][h3]Season 05 Multiplayer Ranked Play (Launch Window)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6cbb59f4e32475ccc159362d0890ff8ca7216715.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Season 05 Ranked Play Overview[/p][p][/p][p]Multiplayer Ranked Play gives players the ultimate competitive experience by offering the same settings, maps, modes, and weapon restrictions used by the Call of Duty League™. [/p][p][/p][p]Earn career rewards throughout the lifespan of [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Multiplayer Ranked Play, including Rank Skins and Win Challenge rewards. Each season comes with its own seasonal rewards that can only be earned throughout the duration of that season, including the following:[/p][p][/p][p]Season 05 Ranked Play Rewards[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4d91a92bdd952da335ce92513e94bf896214b62e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The following Weapon Blueprint, Large Decal, Calling Cards, and Weapon Camos are only available during Season 05:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Get 10 Wins:[/b] Pro Re-Issue MPC 25 SMG Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Get 100 Wins:[/b] “Ranked Season 05 — 100 Wins” Large Decal[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Reach Silver Rank:[/b] “Ranked Season 05 — Silver” Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Reach Gold Rank:[/b] “Ranked Season 05 — Gold” Calling Card and Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Reach Platinum Rank:[/b] “Ranked Season 05 — Platinum” Calling Card and Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Reach Diamond Rank:[/b] “Ranked Season 05 — Diamond” Calling Card and Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Reach Crimson Rank:[/b] “Ranked Season 05 — Crimson” Calling Card and Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Reach Iridescent Rank:[/b] “Ranked Season 05 — Iridescent” Animated Calling Card and Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Finish Season 05 at the Top 250 Rank:[/b] “Ranked Season 05 — Top 250” Animated Calling Card and Animated Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Finish Season 05 at the Top 250 #1 Overall:[/b] “Ranked Season 05 — Top 250 Champion” Animated Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7: Zombies[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]ZOMBIES CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Survival Map:[/b] Return to the frozen land of the giants in the Eidskallen Lighthouse Survival map. Push the rounds as far as you can using the resources available in a confined section of Totenreich and earn rewards for reaching round milestones.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Kowakujō Directed Mode, Starting Room:[/b] Benefit from extra guidance on the Main Quest as Directed Mode comes to Kowakujō. In Starting Room, drop into the Outer Ward and survive with whatever’s on hand. [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Rogue Run Playlists:[/b] Astra Malorum arrives in Rogue Run through three new playlists offering increasingly difficult challenges, featuring Calling Card and GobbleGum rewards to help you push further in the match. Survive each wave, choose your power up, then teleport to the next area.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Mid-Season Round-Based Map, Features:[/b] Make your stand and face the Warden in the final confrontation as the Black Ops 7 Zombies story reaches its epic conclusion in the Mid-Season. newsitems.title: Former Marathon director settles lawsuit against Sony and Bungie, following his firing over alleged inappropriate messages to female staff
newsitems.contents:
Former Marathon director Christopher Barrett has settled his lawsuit against Sony and Bungie. He filed the lawsuit against the studio after a quiet departure which was confirmed in March 2024.

Bloomberg reported in August 2024 that Barrett had been fired after he was accused by several female Bungie staff of inappropriate behaviour. newsitems.title: Season 5, Armory, and More
newsitems.author: brianlev

[h3]Reporting for Active Duty[/h3]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/bace68e72c87d8b04e5b28953e2de63dda54d9c8.png[/img]
Cache has officially arrived, and replaces Overpass in the active duty map pool. Put your hard-earned strats to the test and rise through the Premier ranks in CS2's newest battlefield.

[h3]Get out of there, it's gonna blow![/h3]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/ace20715ffc694f3f4b2cad5e1f0db5c00340b00.png[/img]
Season 5 has arrived with some explosive changes to CS2--bomb damage has been completely reworked.

Now, when the bomb detonates, an explosive wave of destruction will flow from the bombsite through the map. As before, if you're too close to the bomb when it explodes, you're toast--but the shockwave dissipates around corners and doesn't go through walls, so at a certain distance you can use your wits to survive. Or, if you're not confident your wits are up to the task, check your health bar which will flash a preview of how well you'll fare after the blast. 

[h3]Answering the Call[/h3]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/33b94ca261b8ca57c089ed7e139717bb51915bc4.png[/img]
We sent out a call to arms recently for some new weapon and sticker collections, and the community answered! Head to the Armory, where you'll find two new weapon collections, Arabesque and  Spy Tech.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/caab8a836c22e0fa30b7ecce05d837a7e328682c.png[/img]
Two new sticker collections, Fruits & Vegetables and Auto Racing, have also been added to the Armory. 

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/6afa2c87197b36855fd352530302cfa6f46d2c3d.png[/img]

[h3]Community Maps[/h3]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/68b88089a85428b03204d15de98ee27575f96554.png[/img]
Speaking of the CS community, there are some new maps to try. Boulder, Fachwerk, and Shelter have been added to Competitive, Casual, and Deathmatch modes, while Debris and El Dorado are now available in Wingman.

[h3]...And More[/h3]

We've fixed some bugs, tweaked some maps, and scoreboard performance has been improved so you can check your stats as often as you like. 

Check out the release notes for all the details in today's update!

newsitems.title: Dota 2's Dark Carnival has begun, with a huge story chapter and five automaton hero personas
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
At last, weeks of speculation and mystery can finally be put to bed: the Dota 2 Dark Carnival has begun. Valve's latest big event is here, and as many were hoping (myself included), it's a full-scale story campaign in a similar format to 2024's Crownfall. This time, the tale opens with Legion Commander and Hoodwink trapped on board a clanking circus train, imprisoned by the dastardly Ringmaster.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: Dota 2's Dark Carnival has begun, with a huge story chapter and five automaton hero personas

newsitems.title: The Dark Carnival
newsitems.author: kyled
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/7942925df6ae43659acf60f2d2ff827461c02485.png[/img]

Don't you hate it when you wake up in a prison car with no memory of how you got there and, worse, no way to escape, only to discover you've been captured by an evil puppet-man as part of some dark bargain with an ancient world-conquering evil? We've all been there.

We're pulling back the curtain on [url=http://dota2.com/darkcarnival]the Dark Carnival[/url], a new ongoing event in the Dota universe. This first part, "Midnight Run", lets you navigate Legion Commander and Hoodwink through a massive, fully-voiced Dota story featuring a spider-legged convoy of deadly robots, heartstopping secrets, and unique rewards.

Today's update features five all-new Automaton Personas (mechanical reimaginings of classic Dota heroes with new animations, effects, icons, and more), 20 new hero sets (some in a brand new treasure, and some that can only be earned by exploring the map and story), and much more. There's [url=http://dota2.com/darkcarnivalcomic]a comic[/url] if you're the kind of person who likes backstory.

But if, much like Legion Commander and Hoodwink themselves, you'd prefer to be thrown into the action without a lot of pesky memories of how you wound up in Ringmaster's prison train, the first stage of Midnight Run is now live in-game and free for all players. This is just the beginning: There are plenty of surprises in Midnight Run, and we're just getting started.

Complete the steps before the match ends to earn a Champion's Quest Contract for the whole squad.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: General Content (END, MP, ZM, WZ)[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]Call of Duty: General Content Summary (All Modes and Games)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Weapons, Attachments:[/b] Rush into battle, an axe in each hand, with the new Executioner’s Duet Melee Weapon. For ranged combat, the iconic AN-94 Assault Rifle returns with its signature quick burst firing mechanism. New Attachments include the XR-3 Ion Vulcan Minigun, DS20 Mirage Dual Fire Kit, and the Velox 5.7 Carbine Chassis.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Events:[/b] This summer, Nick Cage leads the action in a brand-new Event Pass alongside the Summer of Action Daily Login Event, new Multiplayer and Resurgence Ranked Series Events, and the Kowakujō Event, bringing new rewards including Loadout items, Weapon Camos, Double XP Tokens, in-game cosmetics, and more.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Free Trial:[/b] For a limited time, play Multiplayer and Zombies in Black Ops 7 for free![/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Store Offerings:[/b] Look forward to a variety of new Bundles delivering premium content including Ultra Skins, Reactive content, and Mastercraft Weapon Blueprints, including the Tracer Pack: Ironclad Mastercraft Bundle featuring the “Chronovox” Mastercraft Weapon Blueprint for the new Season 04 Reloaded AN-94 Assault Rifle.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Weapons Detail[/h3][p][/p][p]Melee Weapon: Executioner’s Duet[/p][p][i]Melee, Event Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e72f7484b44a45174fe50a9bcf66cc53fcbc7a22.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Levels: [/b]30[/p][p][b]Mastery Badges:[/b] Yes[/p][p][b]Attachments:[/b] None[/p][p][b]Customize Options:[/b] Blueprints[/p][p][/p][p][i]Melee weapon. High damage, short range, and fast attack speed.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Hack and slash foes with the dual wield Executioner’s Duet. With an axe in each hand, be capable of unleashing a variety of slashing attacks designed to chop foes down to size. While the deadly weapon exhibits the shortest attack range of the current Melee Weapons on offer, it makes up for it with the highest mobility rating. Close the distance and start swinging.[/p][p][/p][p]Camos Confirmed: Weapon Prestige > Executioner’s Duet[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/49d38c72b0da963850724bdbdea353da8456dc17.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Universal Weapon Prestige Camos for the Executioner’s Duet (above): Prestige 1: “Labyrinth.” Prestige 2: “Pop.” Prestige Max: “Radiance.”[/p][p][/p][p]Primary Weapon: AN-94[/p][p][i]Assault Rifle, Event Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fb1934f696ca23dde2d5838b77fefed886d6e9c0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Levels:[/b] 42[/p][p][b]MAGS:[/b] 3[/p][p][b]MAG SIZE:[/b] 30[/p][p][b]Mastery Badges:[/b] Yes[/p][p][b]Attachments:[/b] Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods[/p][p][b]Customize Options:[/b] Blueprints, Camo Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).[/p][p][/p][p][i]Full-auto assault rifle. First two rounds fire at a faster rate. Slower handling and mobility.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]The AN-94 makes its triumphant return. Last seen in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, the Assault Rifle features a unique burst mechanism where the first two shots fire at a faster rate before settling into a more moderate fire rate. [/p][p][/p][p]Connecting the first two shots is vital to quickly downing foes, and with burst fire you can benefit from the rapid double tap in fast succession. Luckily, the weapon’s clean iron sights make it easy to acquire targets even without an Optic equipped. Whether downing enemy players, Guild and Fear targets in Endgame, or the undead horde, the AN-94 is a reliable armament capable of performing in a wide variety of combat scenarios.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Prestige Attachment[/i][/b][/p][p][i]Barrel >  15" MFS Triumvirate Barrel[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/725120da90f9b80771466bbed94525a4669b19ba.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Modified barrel that increases hyperburst shot count to three and increases damage to the upper body. Adds a short delay after between hyperburst and full-auto fire and increases recoil.[/p][p][/p][p]Camos Confirmed: Weapon Prestige > AN-94[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d740f2c7eedc74142153a7ec3fa3c05e65442d5f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Universal Weapon Prestige Camos for the AN-94 (above): Prestige 1: “Splat.” Prestige 2: “Prism.” Prestige Max: “Abducted.”[/p][p][/p][h3]New: Weapon Attachments [/h3][p][/p][p]XR-3 Ion Vulcan Minigun (In-Season)[/p][p][i]XR-3 Ion Sniper Rifle, Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p][i]Attachment > Underbarrel[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b2abfbf5ed80e9b6044f84b0b77f57368c0104d4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Maximize control with this side-mounted foregrip that provides a focused hip fire with reduced spread and improved aiming movement speed. Blocks Optic Attachments.[/p][p][/p][p]DS20 Mirage Dual Fire Kit (In-Season)[/p][p][i]DS20 Mirage Assault Rifle, Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p][i]Attachment > Underbarrel[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9bb2f810b40e192d5ce63b535da8c4892ca60bf2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Replaces ADS with high-powered slug rounds. Greatly improves hipfire accuracy, at a small cost to mobility. Blocks Optic Attachments.[/p][p][/p][p]Velox 5.7 Carbine Chassis (In-Season)[/p][p][i]Velox 5.7 Pistol, Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p][i]Attachment > Barrel[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/642e99ce0018d7f344c6c9fa2b4cad1ed51ee657.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Pistol chassis that converts the Velox 5.7 to full-auto and gives improved range capabilities, at the expense of baseline handling. Unlocks underbarrel and stock customization options.[/p][p][/p][h3]Season 04 Reloaded Events[/h3][p][/p][p]Season 04 Reloaded delivers new challenges and rewards across multiple exciting events including an Event Pass starring Nick Cage. newsitems.title: Valve calls out Dota 2 dataminers desperate for Dark Carnival news: "Why are you guys reading our variable names?"
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
Rumors of a new Dota 2 event called Dark Carnival have been swirling among the MOBA's community for several months, with the leading speculation being that Valve is preparing a new, large-scale feature in the vein of 2024's Crownfall. Lately, in-game signs have suggested that something, at least, is on the horizon, and now eager dataminers have dug out a fresh line in the game's code that doubles down on that promise. In response, Valve has promptly changed the wording, turning it into a direct call-out message instead.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: Valve calls out Dota 2 dataminers desperate for Dark Carnival news: "Why are you guys reading our variable names?"

newsitems.title: Modern Warfare 4: Campaign Early Access Confirmed
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/88c8fabaedf1c35cec50fafbf05ba805943df2da.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This is Warfare Without Limits. Experience the gripping story of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] first with our Campaign Early Access. Here’s how:[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]How Do I Access Modern Warfare Campaign Early Access?[/h2][p align="start"][i]Pre-Order, Play Early[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fc1fde9de49a69f09bcbf9fcce54458ed264a7dd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] Campaign Early Access is confirmed![/p][p align="start"]Starting on Friday, October 16, players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] get Early Access to the game’s Campaign.[/p][p align="start"]This benefit applies to those pre-ordering or pre-purchasing the Standard Digital Edition or Vault Edition of the game on Steam.[/p][p][/p][h2]No Line Holds Forever[/h2][p align="start"]In the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Campaign, you fight as Private Park, a young South Korean soldier facing live combat for the first time alongside his squad. What begins as a routine mission descends into chaos when North Korea launches a full-scale invasion, forcing Park and his unit into a desperate battle through collapsing cities and counteroffensives.[/p][p align="start"]Beyond the front lines, operator-turned-outlaw Captain Price is operating outside the system he once served.
